steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Choose the Protocol Type (Covid: transfer 5.3 µL, mix 12 µL; UTI & More: transfer 2 µL, mix 4 µL), enter the number of samples for Plate 1‑4 (0‑96, set to 0 to skip a plate), and select the P20‑Multi mount.

steps.title: Process Plate 1 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 1, pick up a fresh tip with the P20 8‑Channel GEN2, mix the source sample, transfer the selected volume to the 384‑well plate (Rows A/C/E…, Columns 1‑12), mix the destination well with the selected mix volume, and discard the tip in the waste bin.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip for the column.
Mix the source sample in the KingFisher 96‑Deepwell plate.
Aspirate the transfer volume (5.3 µL or 2 µL) and dispense into the destination well.
Mix the destination well with the mix volume (12 µL or 4 µL).
Dispose the used tip in the waste bin.

steps.title: Process Plate 2 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 2, pick up a fresh tip, mix the source, transfer the selected volume to the 384‑well plate (Rows A/C/E…, Columns 13‑24), mix the destination well, and place the used tip into the empty tip‑rack slots that were freed after Plate 1.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip for the column.
Mix the source sample.
Aspirate the transfer volume (5.3 µL or 2 µL) and dispense into the destination well.
Mix the destination well with the mix volume (12 µL or 4 µL).
Dispose the used tip in the empty tip‑rack slots previously used for Plate 1.

steps.title: Process Plate 3 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 3, pick up a fresh tip, mix the source, transfer the selected volume to the 384‑well plate (Rows B/D/F…, Columns 1‑12), mix the destination well, and place the used tip into the empty tip‑rack slots freed after Plate 2.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip for the column.
Mix the source sample.
Aspirate the transfer volume (5.3 µL or 2 µL) and dispense into the destination well.
Mix the destination well with the mix volume (12 µL or 4 µL).
Dispose the used tip in the empty tip‑rack slots previously used for Plate 2.

steps.title: Process Plate 4 samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples in Plate 4, pick up a fresh tip, mix the source, transfer the selected volume to the 384‑well plate (Rows B/D/F…, Columns 13‑24), mix the destination well, and place the used tip into the empty tip‑rack slots freed after Plate 3.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip for the column.
Mix the source sample.
Aspirate the transfer volume (5.3 µL or 2 µL) and dispense into the destination well.
Mix the destination well with the mix volume (12 µL or 4 µL).
Dispose the used tip in the empty tip‑rack slots previously used for Plate 3.

steps.title: Complete protocol
steps.instruction: After all selected plates have been processed, the protocol ends.
